headline: Hot PCE and GDP at 8:30 AM plus Amazon after the close land with the 10-year near 5% and Brent above $110, as the Fed holds at 3.75-4.00% with a December hike priced in.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield closed near 5.04% and December hike odds have risen to as high as 83% after the Fed held in a 10-2 vote.
fed: The Fed held at 3.75%-4.00% on Oct 28 with Cook and Hammack dissenting in favor of a hike; Chair Warsh gave no forward guidance and the next FOMC is Dec 8-9.
oil: Brent is about $110-116 (WTI about $101) on Strait of Hormuz shipping attacks and Houthi strikes on Saudi sites, easing slightly as Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials opened talks with Iran.
geo: Middle East escalation (Hormuz, Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia) is the active shock, with the OPEC+ meeting and Iran's planned action against Sinokor vessels on Nov 1 and US midterm elections on Nov 3.
